verdict.rationale: Exa's search response schema documents per-result metadata, including `publishedDate` (ISO timestamp) and `author` [exa-docs-37]. Results are returned as ranked web results with contents tied to each returned URL [exa-docs-60, exa-docs-35], and published-date filtering is supported [exa-gh-9], so the core citation metadata is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: an explicit `title` field in the evidenced response schema, any guarantee that returned URLs are canonical, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how accurate the metadata is.
